mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, it is a clear 70 degrees near Reddan Soccer Park under a waning crescent moon, with an air quality index of 56.
City officials are moving forward with development plans near South Main Street and in Liberty Business Park, while also celebrating the student winners of the I Voted sticker design contest.
There is plenty to do, with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee both happening today, followed by a busy Wednesday featuring the Farmer's Market and various trivia nights.
During the early hours of August 8, officers issued citations to two juveniles on Barbara Street for underage alcohol consumption and curfew violations.
Today is the perfect day for Chocolate Heath Crunch, and you can pick some up starting at 10 AM. If you miss it, tomorrow's flavor will be Chocolate Covered Strawberry.
